what: post-hoc sensitivity of E2's BD measures; the bundle's values are the verdict of record
input_hash: sha256 of each file with CRLF normalized to LF

exact_cubic.method: Lagrange interpolating polynomial through the four points, integrated exactly, 50-digit decimal arithmetic on the floats' exact values

pchip.method: scipy.interpolate.PchipInterpolator on the same axes as the cubic, integrated exactly over the common interval; Amendment 7 f's rule and Amendment 8 a's substitute applied the same way (post hoc)

shn_stream.note: the shN.npz file's bytes (codebook codes and labels)

sign_disagreement.definition: BD-rate and BD-PSNR name different curves as the better one: BD-rate < 0 with BD-PSNR < 0, or BD-rate > 0 with BD-PSNR > 0 (both defined)
